rule_rows.note: Implements the Investment Property matrix check only for loans ≤ $1,500,000; it returns unknown for higher loan amounts, so it does not implement the other tiers in job 36.
Implements the $2,000,001–$3,000,000 portion of the matrix job, including the CLTV comparison; it does not implement the other loan-amount ranges.

Implements the delayed-financing cap, interest-only requirements, and low-loan-amount CLTV limits. Jobs 35 and 49 state the same CLTV check under different names. The rule does not adjudicate the DSCR requirement for loans over $2,000,000.
Checks for a 1007 on a vacant-property purchase, but does not allow the applicable 1025 alternative or check that qualifying rents are actually taken from the required report.
The rule checks the short-term-rental CLTV caps and minimum FICO, which are part of job 9’s applicable CLTV-cap and FICO checks.

Checks several stated minimum DSCRs, including the mixed-use/adult-care threshold and vacant rate-and-term threshold, and flags the unresolved No Ratio interaction. It does not complete the other checks required by those jobs.

Implements parts of the citizenship checks, including foreign-national CLTV/FICO and ITIN limits. It does not establish all required evidence or the foreign-national Primary Residence definition, and its handling of ambiguous limits and ITIN tiers is incomplete.
The rule checks whether tradelines meet a requirement, but none of the listed jobs checks that scores and tradelines are reported under the correct ITIN or SSN.
Checks the business-purpose and investment-property eligibility requirement only.
Checks the business-purpose and investment-property conditions for an entity borrower, but not the ownership, guarantee, title, or entity-structure requirements.

The rule partially checks the required non-first-time-homebuyer status, allowed entity types, and entity-document completeness. It does not check all related requirements, such as prior-homeownership evidence, foreign ownership, or the full documentation standards.
Checks whether required entity documentation is complete and satisfies the stated requirements.
Checks whether required entity documentation is complete.
Applies the printed housing-history CLTV limits, but does not refer the unresolved label-definition and seasoning question for Acra confirmation (Q-05).

The rule implements parts of the event-seasoning, property eligibility/cap, and escrow-waiver checks. It does not refer the FB-taken case-by-case question or resolve mandatory-impound interactions with Acra; it also does not check the DSCR documentation-type requirement.

The rule covers portions of the vacant-property refinance checks (including FICO, CLTV, DSCR, reserves, interest-only restrictions, and ownership timing), but leaves several requirements unresolved or untested. It also applies the above-80% property-type restriction and allows vacant-property purchases, but does not verify the required rent documentation for purchases.
The rule flags whether the property was listed for sale within the six-month lookback. It does not check the other loan-characteristic requirements in either job.
Checks the CLTV-at-or-below-70% exemption from rent loss insurance; it does not implement the other checks in job 62.

Checks the interest-only minimum loan amount and credit score, the 10-year/40-year maximum CLTV and loan amount, and the stated ineligibility conditions. It does not check the interest-only payment mechanics.
Implements the state-specific prepayment restriction predicates, but does not identify the Q-24 confirmation issue for BUY-OUT.
Implements the matrix CLTV check and the below-$200,000 cap. Jobs 35 and 49 state the same small-loan check; the matrix score-band thresholds in the code do not exactly match the listed bands.
The rule checks a 700 minimum FICO for a requested escrow waiver. None of the listed jobs states that check.
Implements job 37’s delayed-financing cap and the cap component of job 53; it does not check job 53’s loan-amount range or increments.
Checks only the FICO floor for loans of $1,500,000 or less; it does not apply the matrix CLTV limits or other matrix tiers.
Fully implements job 40’s loan amount range and increments; implements the shared amount check in job 53 and the FICO eligibility component of job 36, but not their remaining checks.

The rule checks the $1.5MM delayed-financing cap, fully matching job 37 and partially matching job 53. The cap check is duplicated across those jobs; the rule does not check the published loan range or $50 increments.

The rule checks the applicable channel DSCR minimum, matching the overlapping minimum-ratio checks in both jobs. It does not separately evaluate listed-for-sale status; a missing or unavailable ratio returns unknown.

The rule checks first-time-homebuyer and eligible citizenship status, but not the Permanent Resident documentation requirements. It also checks the current-lease requirement for cash-out refinances, but not the rent-schedule or excessive-rent documentation requirements.
The rule checks that the case is not a first-time homebuyer, matching the duplicated eligibility checks in jobs 0 and 9.
Checks the business-purpose investment-property requirement and SPE/non-series-LLC eligibility, but not the other checks in job 5.

The rule checks allowed entity type (part of job 5), documentation completeness (part of job 4), and not-first-time-homebuyer status (part of job 6). The not-first-time-homebuyer check also repeats job 0.
The rule returns the entity-document completeness check described by job 4.
Checks whether the required entity documentation is complete.

Checks the stated eligible/ineligible property types and the 75% CLTV cap for Warrantable Condos and Two-Units, but does not check the location restriction.
The rule repeats job 43’s property-type, CLTV-cap, and location eligibility checks. It also checks vacant-property ineligibility.
Checks only whether CLTV is at or below 70%, corresponding to the rent-loss-insurance exemption. It does not determine the other insurance or reserve-substitution requirements in job 44.

Implements the stated reserve thresholds for CLTV above 75% and property listed for sale within six months, while leaving overlapping triggers unresolved. It does not cover the other reserve triggers in job 20.
Checks the 75.00% CLTV cap and that the property is not listed for sale, but does not check the required 5-year interest-only term.

Checks the SD location restriction, but does not check the U.S. Territories restriction or the other stated caps and adjustments.

Checks the stated six-month reserve trigger when CLTV exceeds 75%; it does not address the other reserve requirements covered by job 20.
For a requested escrow waiver, refers unresolved Section 35 status for confirmation; it does not check the other escrow-waiver requirements.
